keyPoints.en: Health-related: cardiovascular endurance, muscular strength, muscular endurance, flexibility, body composition.
keyPoints.bm: Berasaskan kesihatan: daya tahan kardiovaskular, kekuatan otot, daya tahan otot, kelenturan, komposisi badan.

keyPoints.en: Skill-related: agility, balance, coordination, power, reaction time, speed.
keyPoints.bm: Berasaskan lakuan motor: ketangkasan, imbangan, koordinasi, kuasa, masa tindak balas, kelajuan.

keyPoints.en: FITT: frequency, intensity, time, type. Increase load gradually (progressive overload).
keyPoints.bm: FITT: kekerapan, intensiti, masa, jenis. Tambah beban secara beransur (beban ansur maju).

keyPoints.en: Session: warm-up → stretching → main activity → cool-down.
keyPoints.bm: Sesi: memanaskan badan → regangan → aktiviti utama → menyejukkan badan.

keyPoints.en: SEGAK: step-up, push-up, partial curl-up, sit and reach, BMI.
keyPoints.bm: SEGAK: naik turun bangku, tekan tubi, ringkuk tubi separa, jangkauan melunjur, IJT.

keyPoints.en: BMI = kg ÷ m² (adult normal 18.5–24.9; teens use age charts). Max heart rate ≈ 220 − age.
keyPoints.bm: IJT = kg ÷ m² (normal dewasa 18.5–24.9; remaja guna carta umur). Kadar nadi maksimum ≈ 220 − umur.

tip.en: Square the height first, then divide.
tip.bm: Kuasa duakan tinggi dahulu, kemudian bahagi.
